import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    # Extract source data
    meter_reads = inputs["meter_reads"].copy()
    
    # Step 1: Sort by meter_id ASC, read_ts ASC, read_seq ASC
    meter_reads = meter_reads.sort_values(
        by=["meter_id", "read_ts", "read_seq"],
        ascending=[True, True, True],
        na_position="last"
    )
    
    # Step 2: Dedup - keep LAST row per meter_id
    # This means for each meter_id, keep the last occurrence (latest read in sorted order)
    deduped = meter_reads.drop_duplicates(
        subset=["meter_id"],
        keep="last"
    )
    
    # Step 3: Aggregate by zone
    # Group by zone (treating NULL zone as a real group)
    # Compute SUM(kwh) and COUNT(*)
    aggregated = deduped.groupby(
        by=["zone"],
        dropna=False  # Keep NULL groups
    ).agg({
        "kwh": "sum",
        "meter_id": "count"
    }).reset_index()
    
    # Rename columns to match output schema
    aggregated.columns = ["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]
    
    # Ensure correct column order and types
    zone_totals = aggregated[["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]]
    
    return {"zone_totals": zone_totals}
